interpretation: The available evidence does not satisfy the matched specimen-level gates. This does not establish that correlated random-mass physics is false or that qualifying private data do not exist.

local_variance.reason: No source-qualified local signed-gap, mass, or convertible composition variance is available for a near-critical matched specimen.

correlation_length.reason: No lateral material correlation length is identifiable after measured transfer-function, pixel, and finite-window correction.

same_population.reason: Spatial and spectroscopic records do not refer to one specimen or a quantitatively justified exchangeable population.

near_critical.reason: A near-critical design envelope exists, but no matched specimen-level spatial and spectroscopic evidence exists within it.

resolution.reason: No matched spectroscopy record includes a measured effective energy-resolution kernel.

matched_null.reason: No real matched dataset supports correlated-versus-scalar-null likelihood comparison.

robustness.reason: Specimen-level covariance-family, calibration, background, and prior sensitivity cannot be evaluated without the matched data.

decision_changing.reason: The current evidence cannot determine whether a higher-dimensional or full-Kane calculation is warranted.

retained_assets: R04 analytical filtering, covariance-family, calibration, finite-map, and same-raster inference framework
R05 one-dimensional correlated random-mass versus matched scalar-null method benchmark

non_evidence_constraints.not_equivalent_to: measured probability distribution or matched near-critical specimen evidence
calibrated local DOS, geometry, or measured energy kernel

required: source-qualified local signed-gap or mass variance, or composition with uncertainty-propagated conversion
identifiable lateral correlation length after measured transfer-function correction
matched low-energy spectroscopy from the same specimen or justified exchangeable population
near-critical specimen metadata and same-population linkage
